replacement_reason: The exact all-history co-occurrence implementation exceeded the bounded CPU diagnostic window before emitting metrics. No result was written or used. The replacement changes only the predeclared index-computation bound for deployability.

algorithm.weight: w_ij = sum_{u in U_ij} [1 / log(1 + |I_u|)] / sqrt(N_i N_j)
algorithm.index_input: the most recent min(100, |I_u|) Train target interactions per user, deduplicated in chronological order
algorithm.query_history: the same 10 encoded movie history entries exposed to each Validation query

advancement_rule: The diagnostic cannot deploy. It may justify a separately preregistered merge candidate only if ItemCF has positive unique hits over two-tower@50 and the fixed union improves overall Recall@50 without worsening AQ3 Recall@50 or Tail PQ0 Recall@50 by more than 0.002.
integrity_rules: Do not tune the 100-item bound, merge quota, history weighting, or co-occurrence formula after seeing results.
Retain the exact-ItemCF timeout as an engineering failure.
